messages:
maria: FYI opened a docs PR for the Private/VPC hybrid migration guide — link in PR comment: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482. Need network diagram update + quick SDK conn-check samples for node + go.

jon: Nice. I can take the network diagram update. Do we want the diagram to show dual-NIC edge cases and HA HSM tunnels?

samira: Yes please, include: primary VPC peering -> bastion NAT -> HSM cluster (private subnet) and fallback path via dedicated proxy. Small callout about MTU and TCP MSS.

kevin: I'll draft the Node + Go snippets. Quick question: should the SDK examples use the short-lived KMS token flow or the PKCS#11 example?

maria: Short-lived KMS token + a one-liner note linking to PKCS#11 appendix. Most customers start with KMS tokens.

jon: PR comment says broken link for the offline install checksum section — I fixed the anchor in the doc but it still 404 in the TOC. Anyone else see this?

samira: I saw that too. Looks like build pipeline strips the fragment when redirecting through the static site CDN. I left a note on the PR with suggested fix: make the anchor an explicit h2 ID and update the TOC link to include the full path.

maria: @kevin can you add these two tiny snippets in the PR body so reviewers can copy them directly? Prefer compact examples (3-4 lines) plus one inline comment about token expiry.

kevin: Pushed Node snippet to the PR description. Here's the snippet I added:

```js
// Node conn-check using short-lived KMS token
const rClient = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KMS_TOKEN });
await rClient.status.check({ target: 'private-hsm' });
// token expires in 60s, rotate in CI
```

kevin: And the Go snippet:

```go
// Go conn-check example
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KMS_TOKEN"))
_, err := client.Status.Check("private-hsm")
if err != nil { log.Fatalf("conn check failed: %v", err) }
```

jon: thanks — can you also add the sample curl for the installer preflight? Ops folks like that.

kevin: added a tiny curl for the installer preflight in the PR description:

```bash
# preflight check against local conn-checker
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KMS_TOKEN" \
  https://127.0.0.1:8443/preflight | jq .summary
```

samira: I left inline editorial comments re: MTU/MSS wording and clarified that HSMs must be in private subnets with no public egress. Also flagged the CDN fragment issue.

maria: Great. Two remaining asks before merge: 1) small diagram update from @jon, 2) docs-bot link check must pass (it currently reports one broken anchor).

jon: Uploaded updated diagram SVG in the assets/ folder and referenced it in the migration guide. It shows primary + failover paths and labels the NAT and MTU callouts.

docs-bot: Linkcheck report: 1 failed anchor (offline-install#checksum-verification). Suggested fix: use explicit id on header (id="checksum-verification") and update TOC link to /offline-install/#checksum-verification.

maria: I'll make the tiny header ID change. Once the bot clears, let's squash + merge. Anyone object to a fast-track merge after linkcheck passes?

jon: No objections from infra/docs — fast-track is fine.

samira: No objections from security, just ensure the PKCS#11 appendix is clearly labeled for air-gapped HSMs.

kevin: All set on code snippets and curl. I'll wait for the green linkcheck.

maria: Thanks all — tagging this as ready-for-merge after docs-bot green. Will follow up with a short release note for the customer-facing KB about the MTU caveat. :thumbsup:
